run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 swept across all nine jurisdictions via WebSearch (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). Seven genuinely-new, currently-open opportunities were captured: five Commonwealth via AusTender (NEMA off-grid diesel power generation D2026/72032; National Capital Authority Scrivener Dam Independent Technical Advisor A26/21; ABC National Cleaning Services NS1333; Home Affairs Online-Offline Diversions Project HOMEAFFAIRS/2219/RFT; Australian Antarctic Division Macquarie Island SAB bulk fuel storage ATM25/3151), one NSW via buy.nsw (Transport Asset Manager of NSW - St James Tunnels tour-operator RFP, evolved from RFI WS5525246815, closing 1-Oct-2026), and one WA GBE via Tenders WA (Water Corporation Cocos West Island SWRO plant WC7000015480). Tier 2 sampled: universities (University of Sydney and ANU TenderLink portals), local government (VendorPanel public tenders) and GBEs/utilities (Water Corporation captured). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing checked (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne construction, BHP/Woolworths/Coles supplier channels) - all registration- or login-gated with no publicly-advertised RFx visible this run, so only portals were noted and no corporate tenders were fabricated. Five new sources/buyers were recorded, including the ABC Procure Hub e-sourcing platform. As on prior runs, the egress proxy blocked every WebFetch call, so all detail is WebSearch-snippet-derived - no tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened, and every captured tender still needs an authenticated/unblocked detail pass.
gaps: WebFetch was egress-blocked for every tender domain tested this run (www.tenders.gov.au and buy.nsw.gov.au both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED via the network egress proxy, which only whitelists package registries and the Anthropic API). All opportunity detail is therefore WebSearch-snippet-derived; every captured tender still needs an authenticated/unblocked pass to read the notice detail page, specification documents, evaluation criteria, exact closing time/timezone and contacts.

Two captured tenders have unverified closing dates because the notice pages could not be opened: Water Corporation Cocos SWRO (Tenders WA WC7000015480) and Australian Antarctic Division Macquarie Island SAB bulk fuel storage (AusTender ATM25/3151). Both are recorded at headline level with closing_date=null and flagged for a detail pass.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Business Network Discovery (Ariba Discovery), EstimateOne (construction subcontractor packages), BHP, Woolworths, Coles and the major banks were checked; their live RFx are registration- or login-gated and no publicly-advertised corporate tender surfaced this run. Portals/platforms recorded only; no corporate opportunities invented. Management-consultancy and panel RFPs remain invitation-only and out of scope.

NT QTOL: a Department of Logistics and Infrastructure tender closing 26-Oct-2026 (02:00 PM ACST) was visible in search but no confirmable title or tender ID surfaced; deferred to a future run with a working detail fetch.
ACT Tenders (tenders.act.gov.au): no clearly-new opportunity closing October 2026 surfaced via search this run (results were dominated by October-2025 items); coverage deferred to a future run.

University of Sydney (TenderLink) shows several current opportunities (e.g. PROC-2026-293 chiller/cooling-tower replacement, Curriculum Management Technologies EOI, Student Accommodation 2031 EOI, Unified Hybrid Campus Management System - Sensors) but closing dates could not be confirmed via search snippets; deferred to a detail pass rather than captured without dates.
Local government: VendorPanel public tenders could not be individually enumerated via search this run (platform landing pages only); council coverage rotated/deferred to a future run.
recommended_seed_additions: ABC Procure Hub - the Australian Broadcasting Corporation e-sourcing/lodgement platform (respondents to ABC RFPs lodge here). Confirm the canonical Procure Hub URL and track as a corporate/GBE e-sourcing portal.
National Capital Authority (AusTender buyer) - recurring Canberra national-land and dam-safety engineering procurement (e.g. Scrivener Dam).
Transport Asset Manager of NSW (TAM) (buy.nsw buyer) - legacy transport-asset activation projects (e.g. St James tunnels); track as a NSW gov-state buyer.
Australian Antarctic Division / DCCEEW (AusTender buyer) - Antarctic and subantarctic station infrastructure procurement (Macquarie Island Station Project).

tenders.title: Provision of off-grid diesel electrical power generation and distribution equipment for NEMA soft-shelter camps
tenders.description: NEMA has an open approach to market (ATM D2026/72032) for the supply of safe, off-grid diesel electrical power generation, fuel storage and ancillary power distribution equipment to support its two off-grid soft-shelter (tent) camps when deployed to austere locations with limited access to trades. Detail is WebSearch-snippet-derived; the notice detail page and documents were not opened this run.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The supplier must provide off-grid, diesel-powered electrical generation and distribution equipment able to be deployed to austere locations to power two NEMA soft-shelter (tent) camps. Per the listing snippet this includes generator sets in the 200-250 kVA range, synchronisation boxes, mains distribution box(es) with three-phase and single-phase (230V) outlets, and shielded power cables. Full specification, quantities, delivery terms and support requirements were not read from the tender documents (WebFetch was egress-blocked this run).
key_deliverables: Mains distribution box(es) with three-phase and single-phase 230V outlets
Fuel storage and ancillary electrical power distribution equipment
tenders.eligibility: Open to all (open approach to market)
tenders.briefing: Industry briefing scheduled 6 October 2026 at 14:00 (per listing snippet).
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of the AusTender current ATM list (buyer-originated Commonwealth procurement portal). Buyer NEMA. Deliverable detail is snippet-visible; full scope requires opening the AusTender detail page / documents (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).
tenders.notes: Headline + snippet-level. Closing date/time not stated in the snippet (industry briefing 6-Oct-2026); publish date, exact quantities, evaluation criteria, value and contacts still need verification from the notice and documents. Detail fetch blocked this run.

tenders.deliverables_summary: The consultant must provide Independent Technical Advisor services for the dam-safety management of Scrivener Dam, including regular audits to assess the NCA's compliance with its Dam Safety Management Plan and the provision of independent technical advice on dam safety. Full scope, deliverable schedule, audit frequency and reporting requirements were not read from the tender documents (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).

Independent technical advice for dam safety management of Scrivener Dam
requirements: Suitably qualified and experienced dam-safety / engineering consultant
tenders.eligibility: Open to all (open approach to market)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender (buyer-originated Commonwealth portal). Buyer National Capital Authority. Snippet notes this ATM (A26/21) was re-advertised after the previous tender A26/6 was cancelled for non-compliance with the Commonwealth Procurement Rules.

tenders.title: Online-Offline Diversions Project
tenders.description: The Department of Home Affairs is seeking a supplier to design, deliver and evaluate a scalable, behaviour-led, ideologically neutral diversion capability that identifies individuals online showing early behavioural indicators of vulnerability to radicalisation and diverts them to support services. Snippet-derived from the AusTender listing; detail documents not opened this run.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The supplier must identify innovative approaches to early intervention that reduce the likelihood of individuals progressing toward harmful outcomes, up to and including terrorist or violent extremist acts. It must design, deliver and evaluate a scalable, behaviour-led and ideologically neutral diversion capability that detects individuals online exhibiting early behavioural indicators of vulnerability to radicalisation and diverts them to support services, delivered across pilot, refinement and scaling phases. Full scope, evaluation criteria, security requirements and pricing were not read from the tender documents (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).
key_deliverables: Design of a behaviour-led, ideologically neutral online diversion capability
Delivery of the capability across pilot, refinement and scaling phases
Evaluation of the capability and its outcomes
tenders.scope_of_work: Two-year project delivered over pilot, refinement and scaling phases; proposed start 16 November 2026; delivery period ending 30 June 2028 with two possible 12-month extensions. Location noted as Docklands, VIC.
tenders.eligibility: Open to all (open approach to market)
tenders.contract_term: Two years (to 30 June 2028) with two 12-month extension options
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender (buyer-originated Commonwealth portal). Buyer Department of Home Affairs. Rich scope, term and start-date detail were snippet-visible; full documents require opening the notice (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).
tenders.notes: Closing 2-Oct-2026 2:00 PM ACT Local Time per listing snippet. Contract term/start/end and Docklands location snippet-derived; publish date, evaluation criteria, value and contacts still need verification from the notice/documents. Detail fetch blocked this run.

tenders.title: Tour Operator: Unlock St James Tunnel (Request for Proposal)
tenders.description: Transport Asset Manager of NSW (TAM) is seeking a tourism operator to deliver a high-quality, immersive visitor experience within the historic, disused State Heritage Listed rail tunnels at St James, Sydney. The engagement began as an RFI (WS5525246815, closed 27-Feb-2026) and has progressed to a Request for Proposal now in market.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The operator must deliver and run a high-quality, immersive public visitor experience within the disused St James rail tunnels (approx. 600 metres under Hyde Park, accessed from St James station concourse). Recently installed safety equipment, communication systems and multimedia devices now enable safe public access to the State Heritage Listed tunnels. Full commercial model, term, revenue-share, heritage and safety obligations were not read from the RFP documents (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).
key_deliverables: Design and delivery of an immersive visitor / tourism experience in the St James tunnels
Ongoing operation of public access within a State Heritage Listed environment
tenders.scope_of_work: Immersive visitor experience within the ~600m disused St James rail tunnels under Hyde Park, Sydney; contract expected to be awarded in December 2026.
tenders.delivery_location: St James railway station tunnels, Hyde Park, Sydney NSW
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of buy.nsw (buyer-originated NSW procurement portal). Buyer Transport Asset Manager of NSW. The initial RFI (WS5525246815) closed 27-Feb-2026; a full RFP is now in market with tenders closing Thursday 1 October 2026 and award expected December 2026.
tenders.notes: Current live stage is the RFP (closing 1-Oct-2026); dedup keyed to the buy.nsw opportunity ID WS5525246815 from the original RFI. The RFP may carry a distinct RFP ID not captured this run. Contract term/value, evaluation criteria and exact closing time still need verification from the RFP documents. Detail fetch blocked this run.

tenders.title: Replacement of Special Antarctic Blend (SAB) Diesel Bulk Storage Infrastructure at Macquarie Island
tenders.buyer: Australian Antarctic Division (Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water)
tenders.description: The Australian Antarctic Division (AAD), part of DCCEEW, is running a single-stage open tender for the supply of components for Special Antarctic Blend (SAB) bulk fuel storage infrastructure to replace the existing bulk fuel farm at Macquarie Island, supporting the Macquarie Island Station Project (MISP). Snippet-derived from AusTender; detail documents not opened this run.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The supplier must provide a complete and operable Bulk Fuel Farm System to replace the existing bulk fuel farm at Macquarie Island, including nine (9) x 36 kL above-ground, double-walled, category 3 stainless steel fuel storage tanks and associated componentry for Special Antarctic Blend (SAB) diesel. Full technical specification, delivery/logistics scope and conditions were not read from the tender documents (WebFetch egress-blocked this run).
key_deliverables: Nine (9) x 36 kL above-ground, double-walled, category 3 stainless steel fuel storage tanks
Associated componentry for a complete and operable bulk fuel farm system
tenders.scope_of_work: Supply of components for SAB bulk storage infrastructure to replace the existing bulk fuel farm at Macquarie Island Station, supporting the Macquarie Island Station Project (MISP).
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender (buyer-originated Commonwealth portal). Buyer Australian Antarctic Division (DCCEEW). A related "Notice 2 - 25/3151" also appears, indicating an active/updated process.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Closing date NOT verified this run (snippet indicated a Q3 2026 commencement but no confirmed closing date; WebFetch egress-blocked). Publish/closing dates, value, evaluation criteria and contacts still need verification from the AusTender notice/documents.
